findings.title: Concurrent-deletion NPE remains in getSubGroupsStream overloads
findings.body: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount now guards against modelSupplier.get() returning null, but getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer), getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer), and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...). If the group is deleted concurrently, getGroupModel() can return null for the cached adapter, so these methods will still throw NullPointerException. This leaves the same race unfixed for subgroup pagination/search paths.

findings.title: New concurrency test can pass without detecting failures and may leak thread
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a reader thread but never joins it or otherwise waits for it to complete. The main thread sets deletedAll and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty; the reader may not have performed any request yet, may still be in a request, or may add an exception after the assertion. If a delete call throws before deletedAll is set, the reader thread also loops forever. The test is therefore racy, can pass even when the NPE exists, and can leave background admin requests running after the test.
